description: Synthetic test apartment for the HomeMy test stand. Not a real home. Four rooms, 0.85 m doors, furniture as boxes; the coffee table is four legs because the LiDAR scans below its top. Deliberately asymmetric (Amadeus lesson: symmetric worlds caused false loop closures).
units: metres, world frame; x east, y north

floor_plan.legend: sofa, four coffee-table legs, shelf, kitchen counter, bed, wardrobe

mapping_route.description: The route a person would drive with the controller: every room once.
